# PRD-BLD-01

**Is the design a solution design, accepted, with no open consideration, and has this version had an endorsed design review whose conditions are closed?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Production entry lens](production.md) 0.1.1 |
| Area | BLD: As built |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `design.type`, `design.status`, `considerations.status`, `evidence.type`, `evidence.design_version` |

## Why it matters

The production entry assessment builds on the design review; it is not a way to review a design for the first time on the day it ships.

## Rule

design.type is solution-design; design.status is accepted; no consideration has status open; evidence has an entry of type prior-assessment whose design_version equals design.version.
